name: Adcon Capital Services Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1994, Adcon Capital Services Ltd is engaged in finance and investment activities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
ACSL is in the business of Finance & Trading / 
Investment in Shares & Securities, and other 
related activities of the capital market. The co.
 is registered as a non-systematically important 
non-deposit-taking non-banking financial company.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.39 times its book value
cons: Though the company is reporting repeated profits, it is not paying out dividend
Company has a low return on equity of 2.22% over last 3 years.
